It engages in research, litigation support, and public policy advocacy, including on issues involving technology and AI's effects on workers and health care.
naics.justification: The organization's primary activity is advocating for policy change on women's and family issues, the defining activity of a social advocacy organization.

alternates.justification: Its women's-rights advocacy could equally be read as a human rights organization.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: It produces substantial policy research, which alone would suggest social-science R&D.
A general civic organization reading understates its advocacy focus.

naics.category_justification: It is a mission-driven 501(c)(3) advocacy and research organization rather than a membership trade body or government entity.

naics.description: 3M Innovative Properties Company is a wholly owned subsidiary of 3M Company that holds, manages, and licenses 3M's global intellectual property portfolio, including over 100,000 patents. It handles patent filing, prosecution, and licensing on behalf of its parent, 3M, a diversified industrial and consumer products manufacturer. The subsidiary is the named assignee on many of 3M's patent filings with the USPTO.
naics.naics_title: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)
naics.justification: The subsidiary's defining activity is holding and licensing intellectual property (patents) on behalf of its parent, which matches licensing/leasing of intangible assets.

alternates.justification: As a corporate IP-holding subsidiary, it could alternatively be classified as a holding company office.
Its patents cover parent 3M's diversified manufacturing businesses, which could inform classification if the subsidiary is viewed as inseparable from 3M's manufacturing operations.
The subsidiary's IP-counsel office handles patent prosecution work resembling legal services.

naics.category_justification: It is a for-profit corporate subsidiary of 3M Company managing intellectual property assets.

naics.description: OpenAI is an American artificial intelligence research and product company known for developing large language models and consumer/enterprise AI products such as ChatGPT and the GPT model API. Originally founded as a nonprofit research lab in 2015, it restructured around a capped-profit subsidiary to raise capital while research remains overseen by an affiliated nonprofit entity. OpenAI has been a prominent commenter on federal AI policy and regulation.
naics.justification: OpenAI's primary commercial activity is developing and licensing AI software products (ChatGPT, API access to its models), matching the software-publishing code, though its origins and ongoing work as an AI research organization make a research-focused code a close competitor.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: OpenAI conducts substantial fundamental AI research, which this R&D code also captures well.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: OpenAI's API business involves providing hosted model-inference infrastructure to developers, a plausible alternate primary activity.
Ruled out as a weaker fit; OpenAI sells standardized software/API products rather than bespoke programming services.

naics.category_justification: OpenAI operates commercially through OpenAI Global, LLC, a capped-profit entity that sells AI products and services, though its unusual nonprofit-controlled structure means it does not cleanly fit a standard for-profit company.

naics.resolved_name: Mercyhurst University's Center for Intelligence Research, Analysis, and Training (CIRAT)
naics.description: CIRAT is a university intelligence-analysis hub at Mercyhurst University that monitors and analyzes geospatial intelligence platforms and generative AI solutions, partnering with technology vendors to integrate AI analytics tools. It provides intelligence analysis services and training to private-sector, government, and nonprofit clients while training Mercyhurst students in operational intelligence-analysis processes. It is affiliated with Mercyhurst's intelligence studies program.
naics.justification: CIRAT is a training and applied-research center embedded in a degree-granting university's intelligence studies program, matching this code as it refers to the institution's own academic unit.

alternates.naics_title: All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
alternates.justification: CIRAT provides paid intelligence-analysis services to outside government and private clients, which could be classified as a professional services activity.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Its work analyzing geospatial and AI platforms has an applied R&D character.
Given its intelligence-analysis focus and government clients, a national-security classification was considered but does not fit since CIRAT itself is not a government body.

naics.category_justification: CIRAT is a center within Mercyhurst University's intelligence studies program, referring to the institution's own academic/applied-research unit.

naics.description: The American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonprofit behavioral and social science research organization headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. It conducts research and provides technical assistance in areas such as education, health, workforce development, and international development, often under contracts with government agencies and foundations. AIR is one of the largest nonprofit social science research organizations in the United States.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: AIR's primary activity is conducting behavioral and social science research and evaluation, directly matching this code.

alternates.justification: Considered because AIR provides significant technical assistance and evaluation services to education agencies, though its work spans well beyond education into health and workforce research.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Ruled out; AIR's research is predominantly behavioral and social science rather than physical or engineering science.
Ruled out; AIR is a nonprofit contractor performing research, not a government agency administering programs.

naics.category_justification: AIR is a nonprofit research organization conducting mission-driven social science research and technical assistance.

name: Business Roundtable
affiliation: an association of more than 200 chief executive officers (CEOs) of America's leading companies, representing every sector of the U.S. economy

job_title: Privacy and Civil Liberties Engineering Lead
name: Arnav Jagasia
affiliation: Privacy and Civil Liberties Engineering Lead, Palantir Technologies

naics.description: Palantir Technologies is a publicly traded American software company that develops big data analytics and AI platforms used by government agencies (including defense and intelligence customers) and commercial enterprises. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado, it is known for its Gotham and Foundry data-integration platforms.
naics.justification: Palantir's primary business is developing and licensing proprietary data analytics and AI software platforms, matching software publishing.

alternates.justification: Palantir also performs significant bespoke deployment and custom engineering work for government and enterprise clients.
Much of Palantir's revenue comes from integrating its platforms into client-specific systems.
Not a fit; included only because it appeared in the candidate shortlist due to keyword overlap with government/defense work.

naics.category_justification: Palantir is a publicly traded, for-profit software company commenting in its own commercial interest.

name: Patrick Hall
affiliation: Advisor at H2O.ai, Principal Scientist at bnh.ai, Visiting Professor at GWU

naics.description: H2O.ai is a venture-backed technology company that develops open-source and enterprise software platforms for machine learning and generative AI, including its H2O and H2O LLM Studio products. The company is headquartered in Mountain View, California, and serves enterprise customers building and deploying AI models. It has been an active commenter on federal AI policy.
naics.justification: H2O.ai's primary activity is developing and licensing machine learning and AI software platforms, matching this software publishing code.

alternates.justification: Considered given its enterprise services and support offerings, though its core products are licensed software platforms.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Considered due to its heavy investment in AI research, though it commercializes this research as software products.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Ruled out; H2O.ai is primarily a software vendor rather than an infrastructure/hosting provider.

naics.category_justification: H2O.ai is a for-profit, venture-backed AI software company commenting in its own commercial capacity.

naics.description: RAND Corporation is a nonprofit, nonpartisan research institute headquartered in Santa Monica, California, that conducts policy analysis and research for U.S. and international government agencies, militaries, and other clients across national security, health, economics, and technology. It operates several federally funded research and development centers (FFRDCs) and publishes extensively on public policy issues, including AI governance. RAND funds a graduate school, the Pardee RAND Graduate School, as part of its research mission.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: RAND's primary activity is conducting contract research and policy analysis across social science, economic, and policy domains, matching this R&D code even though it also touches technical and security topics.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: RAND also conducts substantial technical, engineering, and national-security research that spans beyond social sciences.

alternates.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Some RAND engagements resemble policy consulting, though its core identity is research rather than consulting.
RAND operates a graduate school, but that is a subsidiary activity of the larger research institute.

naics.category_justification: RAND is organized as a nonprofit research institute rather than a government agency, university, or membership association, though it operates federally funded research centers.

name: Neil Chilson
affiliation: Head of AI Policy, The Abundance Institute

naics.description: The Abundance Institute is a mission-driven nonprofit think tank, led by CEO Chris Koopman and supported by Stand Together Trust, focused on removing societal and policy barriers to emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, quantum computing, nuclear energy, and nanotechnology. It advocates for a pro-innovation, limited-government regulatory approach and produces policy research and recommendations, including comments on federal AI action plans. It also supports talent development for founders and innovators in these fields.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: The Institute's primary activity is producing policy research and recommendations advocating for particular regulatory approaches to emerging technology, matching social-science research and development.

alternates.justification: Very close alternate given the Institute's clear policy-advocacy orientation and lobbying-adjacent activity.
Considered given its support of a community of founders and innovators, though it is not structured as a dues-paying business membership association.
Ruled out; the Institute is itself supported by an outside funder rather than primarily acting as a grantmaker.

naics.category_justification: The Abundance Institute is a mission-driven nonprofit think tank advocating for specific technology policy positions.

name: Doug Hohulin
affiliation: President/Founder of Exponential Blueprint Consulting LLC

naics.description: Exponential Blueprint Consulting LLC is a small consulting firm founded by Doug Hohulin, a former Motorola and Nokia executive, focused on advising organizations on emerging and exponential technologies including AI, in areas such as healthcare, autonomous vehicles, education, and energy policy. The firm's founder has co-authored books on future technology trends. It appears to operate as a small independent management consultancy.
naics.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
naics.justification: The firm's primary activity is providing general strategic and management consulting on technology trends and policy to organizations across industries.

alternates.justification: Considered as a close alternative since the firm's advisory work spans multiple specialized topics rather than fitting neatly into administrative/general management consulting.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Considered given the firm's technology and scientific-trend focus, which could fall under technical consulting rather than general management consulting.
Considered because the founder is also an author, but this is secondary to the firm's consulting activity.

naics.category_justification: It is a for-profit, independently owned consulting LLC commenting on its own behalf, though it may act in an advisory capacity representing views on behalf of unnamed clients on some topics.

name: Oliver Smith
affiliation: EI Expert and Founder of Daedalus Futures

naics.description: Daedalus Futures is a consulting firm focused on strategy and advisory services for transformational and responsible AI, helping organizations navigate AI regulatory and governance complexity. Limited independent information is available about the firm's size, ownership, or client base beyond its own website. It appears to operate as a boutique AI policy and strategy consultancy.
naics.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
naics.justification: The firm's stated primary activity is providing strategic and policy advisory consulting services related to AI governance, matching general management consulting.

alternates.justification: A close alternative given the specialized nature of AI governance consulting, which may not fit neatly into general management consulting.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Considered given the technical/AI-specific nature of its consulting work.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: Ruled out; the firm markets itself as a consultancy, not a research institution.

naics.category_justification: It presents itself as a for-profit consulting firm, though details on its size and structure are limited, and it may advise clients rather than act on its own behalf on some matters.

name: Percy Liang

naics.description: Stanford University is a private research university located in Stanford, California, offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs across a wide range of disciplines. It is one of the world's leading research institutions, with extensive activity in fields including computer science, engineering, medicine, and public policy. Numerous Stanford-affiliated centers and faculty regularly engage in public policy research and comment on federal technology and AI policy.
naics.justification: Stanford University is a degree-granting university, the defining activity of this NAICS code.
naics.category_justification: Stanford is an unambiguous private research university.

naics.description: The General Services Administration (GSA) is a U.S. federal government agency that manages federal real estate, procurement policy, government contracting, and technology and administrative services for other federal agencies. It operates the federal fleet, manages federal buildings, and runs government-wide acquisition programs. GSA supports the operations of the broader federal government rather than delivering services directly to the public.
naics.justification: GSA's core function is providing administrative, procurement, and property-management support across the federal government, which does not fit a single specific program-administration code but matches general government support.

alternates.justification: GSA administers government-wide acquisition and economic support programs, which overlaps with this code.

alternates.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
alternates.justification: GSA provides management and administrative services to other agencies, similar in nature to management consulting, though it is a government body, not a private consultancy.
GSA is unrelated to education administration; included only as a low-likelihood alternative from the candidate list.

naics.category_justification: GSA is a federal executive branch agency.

organization: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA)
name: Andrew Jenks
affiliation: Chairman Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA)
org_normalized_name: coalition for content provenance and authenticity
org_display_name: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA)

naics.resolved_name: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (a Joint Development Foundation project of the Linux Foundation)
naics.description: The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) is an industry standards coalition formed by companies including Adobe, Microsoft, Intel, Sony, and the BBC, operating as a Joint Development Foundation project under the Linux Foundation. It develops open technical standards for certifying the source and edit history (provenance) of digital media to combat misinformation and establish content authenticity. Its specifications underpin content credentials for images, video, and AI-generated media.
naics.justification: C2PA's primary activity is convening member companies to develop shared industry standards, which is characteristic of a business association.

alternates.justification: Standards development bodies are sometimes classified with professional organizations.

alternates.naics_title: All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
alternates.justification: Technical standards drafting could be treated as a specialized technical service.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Its technical specification work loosely resembles scientific/technical consulting, though it serves members rather than clients.

naics.category_justification: C2PA is explicitly a multi-company coalition organized to advance its members' shared interest in content-provenance standards.

name: American Chamber of Commerce in Portugal - AmCham Portugal
Bernardo A. Huberman

naics.description: HP Labs is the corporate research and development division of HP Inc., the personal computing and printing hardware company that resulted from the 2015 split of the original Hewlett-Packard. HP Labs conducts exploratory and applied research in areas such as computing, materials science, and 3D printing to support HP Inc.'s product businesses. It has commented on federal AI-related rulemakings.
naics.justification: As HP Inc.'s internal research arm, HP Labs' work supports and shares the primary activity of its parent, which is manufacturing personal computers and related hardware.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Viewed as a standalone R&D unit, HP Labs' primary activity is scientific and engineering research rather than manufacturing.
Some HP Labs work is software-focused, though this is secondary to hardware R&D.
A weaker fit; HP Labs is an internal research unit, not a computer-services provider.

naics.category_justification: HP Labs is a corporate research division of the for-profit company HP Inc., commenting as part of that company's activities.

name: Estelle Wallingford

naics.description: Monash University is a public research university headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, with additional campuses internationally. It offers a broad range of undergraduate and graduate degree programs and conducts extensive research across disciplines including AI and data science. It is one of Australia's largest and most research-intensive universities.
naics.justification: Monash University's primary activity is degree-granting higher education and university research, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: Monash University is an accredited, degree-granting public research university.

naics.description: People For the American Way is a progressive nonprofit advocacy organization based in Washington, D.C., that works to promote democratic values, civil rights, and civil liberties, and to counter what it views as threats from the political and religious right. It engages in public education, grassroots organizing, and policy advocacy on issues including voting rights, judicial nominations, and technology policy. It was founded in 1981 by television producer Norman Lear.
naics.justification: The organization's primary activity is public policy advocacy and civic education on democracy and civil rights issues, matching this social advocacy code.

alternates.justification: Considered given its civil rights focus, though its mission is broader civic/democracy advocacy rather than exclusively human rights work.
Considered given its engagement in political and legislative issues, but it is a nonpartisan 501(c)(3)/(c)(4) advocacy nonprofit rather than a partisan political organization.
Ruled out; its focused policy advocacy mission is more specific than general civic/social activity.

naics.category_justification: It is a mission-driven nonprofit advocacy organization rather than a membership trade body, government entity, or university.

naics.resolved_name: Office of the West Virginia Attorney General
naics.description: The Office of the West Virginia Attorney General is the chief legal office of the state of West Virginia, responsible for representing the state in litigation, enforcing consumer protection and antitrust laws, and providing legal opinions to state government. The Attorney General is an elected constitutional officer of the state. The office regularly participates in multistate policy comments, including on technology and AI issues.
naics.naics_title: Other Justice, Public Order, and Safety Activities
naics.justification: The Attorney General's office's primary activity is legal enforcement and public order functions on behalf of the state government, matching this public administration code.

alternates.justification: Considered because the office performs legal work similar to a law office, but as a government entity it is more properly classified under public administration codes.

alternates.naics_title: Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs)
alternates.justification: Ruled out; the office's core mission is legal enforcement, not human resource program administration.

alternates.naics_title: American Indian and Alaska Native Tribal Governments
alternates.justification: Ruled out; not applicable, this is a state government office, not a tribal government.

naics.category_justification: This is a state-level government office headed by an elected state constitutional officer.

naics.description: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is a Japanese multinational financial holding company headquartered in Tokyo, formed in 2005 through the merger of Mitsubishi Tokyo Financial Group and UFJ Holdings. It provides commercial banking, trust banking, securities, credit card, and asset management services through subsidiaries including MUFG Bank and Mitsubishi UFJ Securities. MUFG is one of the largest financial groups in the world, with major operations in the United States.
naics.justification: MUFG's core business, through its principal subsidiary MUFG Bank, is commercial banking, though the parent group also spans trust, securities, and asset management activities.

alternates.justification: MUFG's large securities subsidiary, Mitsubishi UFJ Securities, provides substantial investment banking services, making this a close alternate.
As a financial holding company parent, this code could apply to the top-level corporate entity rather than its operating banking subsidiaries.
Ruled out; asset management is a smaller part of the diversified group's overall business.

naics.category_justification: MUFG is a for-profit, publicly traded multinational financial holding company.

naics.description: The Committee for Justice is a Washington, D.C.-based conservative nonprofit legal policy organization focused on judicial nominations, constitutional law, and civil justice reform. It engages in advocacy and public commentary on legal and regulatory policy issues, including technology and AI regulation as they intersect with legal process. It is not a government body or law firm.
naics.justification: The Committee for Justice's primary activity is public-interest legal advocacy and civic commentary, which best fits a civic/social organization rather than a research-heavy think tank.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: The organization also produces policy analysis and commentary resembling social-science research.
Its focus on judicial and legal issues could suggest a legal-services fit, though it does not practice law for clients.

alternates.naics_title: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)
alternates.justification: A generic fallback for an advocacy nonprofit that doesn't cleanly fit other categories.

naics.category_justification: It is a mission-driven 501(c) advocacy nonprofit focused on legal and judicial policy, not a membership trade body.

naics.description: The Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is a federal executive office within the Executive Office of the President of the United States. It prepares the President's budget proposal, oversees federal agency performance and regulatory review, and coordinates administration policy on management, procurement, and technology, including AI-related federal guidance. It has issued and received comments on numerous AI and data policy proceedings.
naics.justification: OMB's primary activity is federal executive-branch budget preparation and management oversight, which is the defining activity of this code.

alternates.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
alternates.justification: OMB performs management-oversight functions similar in description to consulting, but as a government office rather than a for-profit consultancy, this code is a poor category fit.
OMB's budget and economic-policy role overlaps somewhat with this code, but Executive Offices is the more precise fit for a central executive-branch office.

alternates.naics_title: Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs)
alternates.justification: Weak fit; included only as one of the shortlisted candidates.

naics.category_justification: OMB is a federal executive office of the U.S. government.

naics.resolved_name: Argonne National Laboratory (U.S. Department of Energy)
naics.description: Argonne National Laboratory is a U.S. Department of Energy multidisciplinary science and engineering research laboratory located near Chicago, Illinois. It conducts federally funded research in areas including high-performance computing, materials science, energy technology, and artificial intelligence, and operates major scientific user facilities. Argonne is managed on behalf of DOE by UChicago Argonne, LLC, a partnership between the University of Chicago and Jacobs Engineering.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
naics.justification: Argonne's primary activity is conducting physical science and engineering research and development across multiple scientific disciplines.

alternates.justification: Argonne conducts some nanoscience research, but this is only one of many research areas, not its overall primary activity.
Not a strong fit; Argonne's research is broader than space-specific research despite the public-administration R&D code covering federal science facilities.
Argonne is closely tied to the University of Chicago but does not itself grant degrees.

naics.category_justification: Argonne is a U.S. Department of Energy national laboratory (a federal facility), even though day-to-day management is contracted to a nonprofit/industry consortium.

name: Ayodele Odubela
affiliation: Founder of the AI ALT Lab

naics.description: AI ALT Lab is an organization that describes itself as working to provide independent assessment and verification of AI tools, and to build participatory forms of AI literacy and citizenship by connecting affected communities with AI developers. It offers training, resources, and frameworks to help translate ethical AI principles into practice. Limited independent verification of its organizational structure or funding was available beyond its own website.
naics.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
naics.justification: The organization's described activity is providing independent technical assessment, training, and advisory services related to AI ethics and trustworthiness, which loosely fits scientific and technical consulting.

alternates.justification: Its stated mission of building AI literacy and connecting affected communities with developers has a strong advocacy and public-education character, making this a strong alternate.
Considered given its emphasis on training and education resources on AI, which fits educational support activities.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Ruled out as lower likelihood; the organization emphasizes assessment and education over conducting original technical research.

naics.category_justification: While the organization has a public website describing its mission, independent verification of its legal structure (nonprofit, business, or other) could not be confirmed.

name: Norman Sadeh
affiliation: Professor/Co-Director, CMU Privacy Engineering Program Institute for Software Research, School of Computer Science

naics.resolved_name: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science
naics.description: The School of Computer Science is an academic college within Carnegie Mellon University, widely regarded as one of the top computer science schools in the world. It offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs and conducts extensive research in computer science, robotics, machine learning, and human-computer interaction. It is a major hub for AI-related research within Carnegie Mellon University.
naics.justification: The School of Computer Science is an academic unit of Carnegie Mellon University, whose primary activity is degree-granting higher education, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: The associated record identifier ties this school to Carnegie Mellon University, a private research university.

naics.description: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) is the independent federal agency of the U.S. government responsible for the civilian space program, as well as aeronautics and space research. It conducts and funds scientific research, space exploration missions, and technology development, including AI applications for space science. NASA is headquartered in Washington, D.C. with numerous field centers across the United States.
naics.justification: NASA's primary activity is conducting and funding space research and aeronautics technology development, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: NASA is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government.

naics.description: Dell Technologies Inc. is a publicly traded American multinational technology company that designs, manufactures, and sells computer hardware, including servers, storage, and PCs, along with related enterprise IT and AI infrastructure solutions and services.
naics.justification: Dell's core activity is designing and manufacturing computer hardware (servers, PCs, storage systems), the defining activity of this code.

alternates.justification: Dell also provides substantial enterprise IT consulting and systems-integration services alongside hardware sales.

alternates.naics_title: Computer and Computer Peripheral Equipment and Software Merchant Wholesalers
alternates.justification: Dell sells hardware through direct and wholesale channels, though manufacturing is its core defining activity.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Dell offers some cloud/infrastructure services, but this is secondary to its hardware manufacturing business.

naics.category_justification: Dell Technologies is a publicly traded, for-profit computer hardware and IT services company.

naics.description: The Tennessee Justice Center (TJC) is a nonprofit public interest law firm and policy advocacy organization based in Nashville, Tennessee. alternates.justification: Considered because it provides direct legal representation like a law firm, which would typically fall under Offices of Lawyers, but its nonprofit public-interest advocacy mission is the more defining characteristic.

alternates.naics_title: Other Justice, Public Order, and Safety Activities
alternates.justification: Considered given its legal/justice focus, but it is a private nonprofit, not a government justice agency.

naics.category_justification: TJC is an explicitly nonprofit, privately funded 501(c)(3) public interest law and advocacy organization.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

naics.category_justification: Qualcomm is a publicly traded, for-profit semiconductor and technology company commenting in its own commercial interest.

DIA is headquartered at Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling in Washington, D.C.
naics.justification: DIA's primary activity is providing military intelligence in support of national security, directly matching this code.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Considered because DIA also engages in technical analysis, but its core mission is intelligence/national security, not R&D.

alternates.naics_title: Other Justice, Public Order, and Safety Activities

It develops measurement standards, technology guidelines, and conducts scientific research across fields including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, physics, and engineering. NIST plays a leading role in shaping federal AI and privacy technical standards.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
naics.justification: NIST's core activity is conducting physical science, measurement, and engineering research; government research establishments producing R&D of this kind are generally coded to the corresponding private-sector R&D code rather than a Public Administration code, since sector 92 is reserved for uniquely governmental functions.

alternates.justification: The only R&D-specific Public Administration code, but it is narrowly defined for space research and does not fit NIST's broader measurement-science mission.

alternates.naics_title: Regulation, Licensing, and Inspection of Miscellaneous Commercial Sectors
alternates.justification: NIST also develops standards used in regulatory and commercial contexts.
NIST performs significant measurement, calibration, and testing standard-setting work.

naics.category_justification: NIST is an agency of the U.S. federal government (Department of Commerce).

DSI develops frameworks, standards, and quality-assurance programs (such as ARCH-AI and AICentral.org) to guide the safe and effective use of artificial intelligence in medical imaging. It works with government, industry, and clinicians on AI governance in radiology.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: DSI's core work (developing standards, guidance, and quality frameworks for AI in radiology) does not map cleanly onto a manufacturing or clinical code; as a program of a professional medical association, its category follows ACR, though its specific NAICS activity is closer to standards/policy development than to a pure research code.

alternates.justification: As a program of the American College of Radiology, a professional membership association, DSI's parent activity is operating that association; DSI itself functions as an extension of ACR's standards-setting work for its member radiologists.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: DSI produces guidance frameworks and research on AI implementation, which has a research/policy character.
Its subject matter is radiology, though DSI itself does not provide direct patient imaging services.

naics.category_justification: DSI is a program of the American College of Radiology, a professional membership association for radiologists, and shares that parent's category.

The office has been active in issues involving technology and consumer protection, including artificial intelligence. It is an elected constitutional office within Texas state government.
naics.justification: The office's primary activity is providing legal counsel and prosecuting/litigating on behalf of the state, which is exactly the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: This is a state-level government office (Texas state government, executive branch).

naics.description: Ethical Intelligence is a consultancy focused on AI ethics, offering organizations guidance, training, and presentations on topics such as bias mitigation, transparency, and AI governance. alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: If its work is framed as scientific/technical rather than managerial, this code could apply.

naics.category_justification: It operates as a for-profit consultancy offering paid advisory and training services to client organizations.

alternates.justification: IBM's software segment (including Red Hat) is a major and growing revenue source, making software publishing a strong alternate primary activity.
IBM's historical core business was computer/mainframe hardware manufacturing, still a meaningful segment.

alternates.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
alternates.justification: IBM Consulting is a large business line providing management and strategy consulting alongside technology implementation.
